ns2:course.label: Phonology for Second Language Teachers
ns2:course.description: Applications of linguistics to language learning with special emphasis on learning the sound system of English. The course involves face-to-face and online instruction. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. A linguistics introductory course.
